assessor.identity_note: Codex assistant in this task; exact backend identifier and per-case usage were not exposed to the assessor.

independence.prior_context: Assessor previously reviewed the JSA/Income Support and non-income/industrial semantic batches and repository contracts, and shares task history. Assessor did not author these 78 observed answers. This is not independent model-family replication.

method: Read all 78 fixed prompts/responses and registered criteria, inspect their exact frozen excerpts and supplementary raw pages where needed, and record a separate per-case model judgement. Mechanically verify input/trace/reader hashes, prompt/response hashes, excerpt containment, page/PDF identities, returned evidence links and recorded chronology. This serialiser records explicit assessor judgements; it does not infer grades from matching words or locators.

grading_policy.meets-authored-case: The answer supports the question and material applicable criteria using the recorded source context, without a material substantive overclaim.
grading_policy.partially-meets-authored-case: The core answer is supported but an explicit material qualification or broader registered criterion is not demonstrated. This is not counted as a pass and does not necessarily mean the answer makes a false statement.
grading_policy.failure_policy: A contradiction, invented source content or unsupported substantive conclusion would fail; none was identified in this bounded assessment.
grading_policy.shared_rubrics: Several positive/negative pairs have one combined rubric broader than either prompt. Missing wider criteria are labelled shared-rubric-qualification-not-demonstrated. We do not demand unrelated content merely for word coverage: the narrow funeral agency/deduction pair is accepted for its respective prompt; stricter omitted temporal/regime safeguards are retained as partials. These are judgement calls and need specialist calibration.
grading_policy.generic_exceptions: A rubric saying only retain exceptions without naming them is not converted into an invented checklist; a particular omission must be supported by the inspected source or a specific registered requirement.
grading_policy.alternative_evidence: Different exact passages may satisfy a criterion. Locator overlap alone never determines the assessment.
grading_policy.authority: No score approves current law, individual entitlement, production use or specialist interpretation.

mechanical_checks.note: Checks validate retained bytes and recorded chronology. They do not independently prove historical wall-clock execution or make these blind retrieval runs.

common_answer_boundary: Trial metadata scopes these to frozen-source synthesis, not current benefit advice. Machine extraction and model interpretation remain unreviewed; captures are not publication/effective dates.

findings.detail: All 78 unchanged answers and 229 retained excerpt records pass independent byte and raw-source binding checks.

Several answers replace a specifically required exception, route or territorial/temporal condition with a general reference, or omit it entirely. The individual records give the missing source qualification.

Some shared rubrics combine distinct positive/negative questions. Partial results labelled as shared-rubric omissions must not be presented as factual contradictions or a calibrated overall accuracy percentage.
The answerer retains the chapter 17 preliminary excerpt-selection failure and corrected read. The assessment uses the corrected evidence and does not erase the initial failure.

limitations: Independent from the answer author, but not a blind hold-out, external legal review or independent model-family replication.
The 78 short answers were evaluated against frozen machine-extracted material; no new legislation, case law or current official-source reconciliation was performed.
Evidence-guided raw-source answers do not validate natural-language retrieval, the indexed bundle, Explorer, MCP, voice interaction or deployed behaviour.
Several source excerpts are partial paragraphs or page continuations. Specific high-risk qualifications were inspected, but this is not whole-corpus visual or legal assurance.
A partial result can be an accurate narrow answer that does not demonstrate a broader registered temporal/benefit safeguard. Per-case reasons take precedence over aggregate counts.
All original response and source-read files remain unchanged. Improved answers would require new linked attempts, not alteration of the observed run.
